open_points.subject: advance_run and execute_function_element
open_points.text: - advance_run: [BEHAVIOR] The ports a node's inputs and outputs are checked against MUST come from what the node names: a function node's from read_contract_version of its pinned implementation's contract version, an operation node's from read_binding of its binding_id; they are read once per advance and passed to plan_run as one NodePorts per flow node in node_id order. Every source of an element MUST be passed with its port to deliver_input before the element is executed or reached; an InputMisfit concludes the element contract_violation without running it: runs writes its NodeExecution with executed naming its pinned implementation or binding, the inputs it had with the misfit value among them, no outputs, no resources_used, and started_at and ended_at both the time of the check. A node over an empty list takes its outputs from empty_list_outputs and writes one NodeExecution succeeded with no map_index, executed naming its pinned implementation or binding, with those StoredValues in the same change; it executes and sends nothing.
open_points.other_text: - execute_function_element: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST read the pinned implementation of the node with read_implementation, read every input's bytes with read_value_bytes into PortPayloads by port, take started_at from kernel_now, and call execute_function with the code, the payloads, the contract version's input and output ports and its resource_bounds; it writes no record and returns the outcome for its caller to write.
open_points.question: Must advance_run stop requiring the function-node ports to be read once per advance and passed only through NodePorts, or must execute_function_element's contract or requirements change so it can reuse those already-read ports instead of obtaining the contract version and its ports again through read_implementation?
